meta.source: Built from three screenshots of the Сталь-Плюс storefront (header/catalog, footer, 'Почему нас выбирают'). Colors are sampled pixel-exact; the type scale, spacing and radii are inferred from the screenshots at display resolution and are sensible approximations, not values read from source CSS.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Primary brand color. Header and utility-bar background; large statement blocks. Carry white text and the accent rule on it.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Accent / primary action. Section headings (24px+), stat numbers, line icons, the accent rule under the utility bar, active links. Clears 3:1 on white and on navy (large text and UI marks only) — it is 3.9:1 on white, so never use it for body-size text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on white and surface-muted; also the fill of solid CTA buttons and the footer surface. ~15:1 on white.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Base page surface; product-card and feature-card fills; text on navy, ink and blue fills.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Alternating section background (e.g. 'Почему нас выбирают'). Set ink text and white cards on it.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card / input edges on white and surface-muted. Decorative only (below 3:1) — do not rely on it to carry meaning.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary and caption text: card subtitles, stat labels, breadcrumbs. 3.5:1 on white — reserve for large or clearly secondary text; use ink for anything body-size a reader must parse. Source value kept exact; flagged.

tokens.name: footer-surface
tokens.usage: Dark footer and dark CTA band. Alias of ink. Carry white text; use link-on-dark for links.

tokens.name: link-on-dark
tokens.usage: Link color inside the dark footer. 3.4:1 on footer-surface — below 4.5:1 at the small size the footer uses. Source value kept exact and flagged; prefer white for footer text that must be read.

tokens.name: notify
tokens.usage: Approximate. Sampled from the small cart-count badge — the only status color visible in the source. Confirm the exact hex before using it for alerts or badges.

families.sans: "PT Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero statistics ('120+', '99.9%'). Set in blue over surface-muted.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles. ink on light surfaces, white on navy.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings; set uppercase in blue (e.g. 'ПОЧЕМУ НАС ВЫБИРАЮТ').

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Paragraph copy. ink for primary, text-muted for secondary.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, breadcrumbs, secondary meta. Usually text-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: stat captions, nav items, footer column headers. Set uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Related items in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Compact vertical rhythm inside controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Base unit. Default padding and gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between feature cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grouped blocks within a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a section heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-square
tokens.usage: Default. CTA buttons, cards, product tiles — the brand's corners are square.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Search field and other input pills.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circular elements: social chips, avatars, icon buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting elevation for white cards on surface-muted.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Hover / dropdown elevation (search category menu, cart preview).
